name: Human
headline: height
subtitle: Average adult (measured US averages, age 20 and over)
description: These are measured averages for U.S. adults aged 20 and older from the CDC's National Center for Health Statistics. The average woman is about 5 ft 3.5 in tall and the average man about 5 ft 9 in. Average body mass runs from about 172 lb for women to about 199 lb for men. Individuals vary widely around these means.

measures.label: Height
measures.note: Measured mean standing height, U.S. adults aged 20+: women 63.5 in, men 68.9 in (NHANES, Aug 2021 to Aug 2023)

measures.label: Body mass
measures.note: Measured mean body weight, U.S. adults aged 20+: women 171.8 lb, men 199.0 lb (NHANES, Aug 2021 to Aug 2023)

facts.text: The CDC figures are measured values, not self-reported, taken from the report Anthropometric Reference Data for Children and Adults: United States, August 2021 to August 2023.
Average waist circumference of U.S. adults aged 20 and older is 40.6 in for men and 38.5 in for women.

sources.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
sources.title: FastStats: Body Measurements

caveats: The figures are U.S. national averages. They are not global averages, and average height and weight differ considerably between countries.
The range runs from the female mean to the male mean. It is not the full range of adult sizes.
